en: A multi-view vintage postcard with the Swedish caption "Hälsning från Emmaboda." It shows four scenes: the main street Storgatan with shops and cars; a park lake with a fountain labeled "E. R. sjön"; a small red timber cottage with turf roof labeled "Ryggasstugan Hembygdsgården"; and a memorial stone in a clearing labeled "Mobergstenen," commemorating author Vilhelm Moberg.
